auxiliary.background:
This task reads metadata from the local relational database, not rows, while its table structures appear as rendered text.
The example concerns a file stored locally on disk. The text output can be read directly after the program has finished reading the file at the end of the run for this local database file.
auxiliary.rule:
Because some synthetic tables declare field defaults, applying the minimal schema requirement changes the emitted schema by excluding those defaults.
The example concerns a file stored locally on disk. The text output can be read directly after the program has finished reading the file at the end of the run for this local database file.
auxiliary.background_copy:
This task reads metadata from the local relational database, not rows, while its table structures appear as rendered text.
The complete command is mdb-schema --no-drop-table --no-not-null --no-default-values --no-not_empty --no-comments --no-indexes --no-relations temp.mdb.
